note: Human-approved reconciliation overrides, recorded from the 'Recon Review' sheet tab by read_recon_approvals() and applied to the perf dict BEFORE scoring (apply_recon_overrides), after which score() recomputes every derived bonus. Keyed by stable identity (date + order-independent team pair) via match_key_of() — NEVER the renumbered 'Match N' label. scope: 'match' (use a whole feed S1/S2 for every differing player), 'player' (one stat field; source S1/S2/Manual+value), or 'l2' (accept official cricsheet S2, or keep the held provisional value). RE-KEYED 2026-08-07: approvals still on pre-cricinfo-id pids had silently stopped applying (the row reappeared every run and the L2 baseline fell back to raw cricapi). Mapped via registry/pid_map.json; '_rekeyed_from' preserves the original key. ANY identity migration MUST re-key this file.
